'''Bloodlance''' is a tall bay horse that belongs to [[Harril]]. 

==Activities==
When Harril returns to the [[White Tower]] from Southharbor after [[Aes Sedai]] capture [[Egwene al'Vere]], Harril rides Bloodlance and has him stabled.{{ref/book|11|Prologue}}
